site_brief.title: Super for creators and coaches turning conversations into content and operations

summary: A conversion‑focused niche landing page for creators and coaches who want to turn calls, DMs, and voice notes into published content and repeatable operations. Uses current reporting on computer‑use AI agents (notably Gemini 3.5 Flash) as evidence of the market shift, then positions Super as the sharper alternative for durable, repeated computer‑use workflows via a reusable computer-use cache.
